17868483
LISTING OF CLAIMS
This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the present application.
1. (Currently Amended) A landing gear for a blended wing body aircraft comprising: at least a nose gear disposed longitudinally forward of a center of gravity of an aircraft by a first distance and connected to a nose linkage configured to transfer movement from the at least a nose gear to at least a main gear; at least a main gear disposed longitudinally aft of the center of gravity of the aircraft by a second distance and connected to a main linkage configured to transform movement from the at least a main gear to the at least a nose gear, wherein the main gear is coupled to a lateral shaft, wherein the main linkage is located on the lateral shaft, and wherein the main linkage is located off center of the lateral shaft; and wherein the at least a nose gear and the at least a main gear are linked.
2. (Original) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein the landing gear is further configured to permit an increase in an angle of attack of the aircraft during take-off.
3. (Original) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein the landing gear is further configured to permit a decrease in an angle of attack of the aircraft during landing.
4. (Original) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein the at least a main gear is located aft of at least a portion of a passenger compartment.
5. (Original) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein the at least a nose gear is located at the nose of the aircraft.
6. (Original) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein the at least a nose gear is connected to a pivot piston.
7. (Previously Presented) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein a longitudinal member mechanically links the nose linkage and the main linkage.
8. (Cancelled)
9. (Cancelled)
10. (Previously Presented) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein the landing gear is further configured to form a tricycle arrangement.
11. (Currently Amended) A method of using a landing gear for a blended wing body aircraft comprising: disposing at least a nose gear forward of [[the]]a center of gravity of an aircraft by a first distance; disposing at least a main gear aft of [[the]]a neutral point of the aircraft by a second distance, wherein the main gear is coupled to a lateral shaft, wherein [[the]]a main linkage is located on the lateral shaft, wherein the main linkage is located off center of the lateral shaft; and transferring movement between the at least a nose gear and the at least a main gear through a linkage between a nose linkage and [[a]]the main linkage.
12. (Original) The method of claim 11, wherein the landing gear is further configured to permit an increase in an angle of attack of the aircraft during take-off.
13. (Original) The method of claim 11, wherein the method is further configured to permit a decrease in an angle of attack of the aircraft during landing.
14. (Original) The method of claim 11, wherein the at least a main gear is located aft of at least a portion of a passenger compartment.
15. (Original) The method of claim 11, wherein the at least a nose gear is located at the nose of the aircraft.
16. (Original) The method of claim 11, wherein the at least a nose gear is connected to a pivot piston.
17. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 11, wherein a longitudinal member mechanically links the nose linkage and the main linkage.
18. (Cancelled)
19. (Cancelled)
20. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 11, wherein the landing gear is further configured to form a tricycle arrangement.
